description: This file is a header (.h) file for the xr-audio SDK, defining internal data structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes related to audio processing, resource management, and threading within the xr-voice SDK.

classes.name: xraudio_thread_t
classes.description: Represents a thread with a name, thread ID, and running status.

classes.name: xraudio_main_thread_params_t
classes.description: Parameters for the main thread, including message queue, plugins, and configuration objects.

classes.name: xraudio_resource_thread_params_t
classes.description: Parameters for resource management thread, including shared memory and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: xraudio_rsrc_queue_msg_header_t
classes.description: Header for resource management queue messages, indicating message type.

classes.name: xraudio_resource_entry_t
classes.description: Represents a resource request entry with process ID, message queue, user ID, priority, and resource IDs.

classes.name: xraudio_shared_mem_t
classes.description: Shared memory structure for resource management, tracking user IDs and resource allocations.

methods.name: xraudio_main_thread
methods.description: Main thread function for audio processing.

methods.name: xraudio_thread_create
methods.description: Creates a new thread with specified parameters.

methods.name: xraudio_thread_join
methods.description: Joins a thread, waiting for its completion.

methods.name: queue_msg_push
methods.description: Pushes a message into the message queue.

methods.name: xraudio_resource_list_init
methods.description: Initializes the resource list in shared memory.

methods.name: xraudio_resource_list_get_head
methods.description: Retrieves the head of the resource list.

methods.name: xraudio_resource_list_get_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next resource list entry.

methods.name: xraudio_resource_grant
methods.description: Grants resource access to a process/object.

methods.name: xraudio_resource_fifo_name_get
methods.description: Generates FIFO name based on user ID.

methods.name: xraudio_devices_input_local_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if local input device is valid.

methods.name: xraudio_devices_input_external_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if external input device is valid.

methods.name: xraudio_devices_input_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if input device is valid.

methods.name: xraudio_devices_output_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if output device is valid.

methods.name: xraudio_capture_file_delete_all
methods.description: Deletes all capture files in specified directory.
